column15: Attention, ship: the cafeteria changed its hours.
That doesn't affect us.

column14: Lo sabemos. Queríamos compartir el dolor.
column15: We know. We wanted to share the pain.

column14: Control, he flotado hasta el techo. ¿Cómo bajo?
column15: Control, I floated to the ceiling. How do I get down?

column14: No hay techo. Todo es suelo.
column15: There is no ceiling. Everything is floor.
How philosophical.
Control, do we have permission to sing?
Permission granted. Low volume.
La la la!
Lower.

column14: Control, he puesto mi foto en la pared de la nave.
column15: Control, I put my photo on the ship's wall.
Why?
So I don't miss myself.

column14: Nave, el director dice que sois un ejemplo para todos.
column15: Ship, the director says you're an example for everyone.
A good example?
An example.
Control, are there birthdays in space?
Of course. Whose is it?
Nobody's. But I wanted cake.

column14: Control, este viaje necesita más ventanas.
column15: Control, this trip needs more windows.
We'll tell the designers.
And a sofa.
Not that.
Control, if I sneeze, do we change course?
A tiny bit. Don't do it.
Too late. Achoo!
Correcting course.

column14: El becario ha preguntado si el espacio huele a algo.
column15: The intern asked if space smells like anything.
Like metal. And socks.

column14: Le diremos solo lo del metal.
column15: We'll only tell him the metal part.

column14: Control, he aprendido a dar volteretas sin manos.
column15: Control, I learned to do flips with no hands.

column14: Muy bien. Ahora aprende a parar.
column15: Very good. Now learn to stop.
Control, can you tell me a story?

column14: Érase una vez un kerbal que no tocaba nada.
column15: Once upon a time there was a kerbal who touched nothing.
And what happened?
Nothing. He was happy. The end.
Woohoo! I mean... copy. Very good.
So pretty! Sorry. Data looks correct.

column14: Aquí Control. Esperad, que se me ha caído el bocadillo.
column15: Control here. Hold on, I dropped my sandwich.

column14: ¡Lo sabía! Sabía que funcionaría. Más o menos.
column15: I knew it! I knew it would work. More or less.

column14: Toda la sala está aplaudiendo. Uno llora un poco.
column15: The whole room is clapping. One of them is crying a bit.

column14: Os mando un saludo. No, espera, ese era el botón del café.
column15: Sending you a greeting. No, wait, that was the coffee button.

column14: Control a nave. ¡Ay, perdón, me he sentado en el micro!
column15: Control to ship. Oops, sorry, I sat on the mic!

column14: ¡Bravo! El director ha hecho un bailecito.
column15: Bravo! The director did a little dance.

column14: Recibido. ¿Ha sonado muy serio? Estoy practicando.
column15: Copy. Did that sound very serious? I'm practicing.

column14: Hola, nave. Soy el del turno de noche. Me he traído galletas.
column15: Hello, ship. I'm the night shift. I brought cookies.

column14: ¡Cambio de turno! Os paso con alguien más simpático.
column15: Shift change! I'm handing you to someone nicer.

column14: Atención. Ha entrado una mosca en la sala. Seguimos informando.
column15: Attention. A fly got into the room. We'll keep you posted.

column14: ¡Nos hemos ganado una pizza! Gracias a vosotros.
column15: We earned a pizza! Thanks to you.

column14: Uy, he leído la hoja al revés. Todo bien. Mejor que bien.
column15: Oops, I read the sheet upside down. All good. Better than good.
Control, you sound happy today.

column14: ¡Hay tarta! Y vosotros vais genial. Pero sobre todo, hay tarta.
column15: There's cake! And you're doing great. But mostly, there's cake.

column14: Control, ¿quién está en la radio hoy?
column15: Control, who's on the radio today?

column14: Yo. El de las gafas. El guapo.
column15: Me. The one with glasses. The handsome one.
We don't know who that is.
Control, are you okay? We hear shouting.

column14: ¡Gritos de alegría! Ha ganado nuestro equipo.
column15: Shouts of joy! Our team won.
What team?

column14: El de la oficina. A los dardos.
column15: The office team. At darts.
Control, I can hear you eating.
That's not true.
I can hear you chewing.
It's a very small cookie.
Ship! Ship! We have news.
What is it?

column14: El becario ha aprendido a hacer café.
column15: The intern learned to make coffee.
Finally!

column14: Una pregunta muy científica: ¿qué tal se está ahí?
column15: A very scientific question: how is it up there?
Very good. A bit lonely.

column14: Os mandamos más radio. Más charla.
column15: Then we'll send more radio. More chatting.

column14: Aquí Control. Perdón por el silencio. Estábamos discutiendo.
column15: Control here. Sorry for the silence. We were arguing.
About what?

column14: Sobre quién os hablaba primero. He ganado yo.
column15: About who talks to you first. I won.

column14: Control, ¿por qué hay otra voz en la radio?
column15: Control, why is there another voice on the radio?
That's my colleague. Say hi.
Hello, colleague.

column14: Dice que sois sus favoritos. Yo no lo dije.
column15: He says you're his favorites. I didn't say that.

column14: Control, nos habéis llamado tres veces sin decir nada.
column15: Control, you called us three times without saying anything.

column14: Lo siento. Me gusta el sonido del botón.
column15: Sorry. I like the sound of the button.
Oh! Oh! You're on the big screen! We can see you!
Hello, screen!

column14: Os informamos de que todo va bien. Muy bien. Increíblemente bien.
column15: Letting you know everything is fine. Very fine. Amazingly fine.
That worries me.
Control, are you bored without us?

column14: Muchísimo. Hemos ordenado los lápices por colores.
column15: Very much. We sorted the pencils by color.

column14: Nave, os leo un mensaje de los niños del colegio.
column15: Ship, I'm reading you a message from the school kids.
Go ahead.
They say: is there ice cream in space?

column14: Diles que todavía no. Pero que lo estamos pidiendo.
column15: Tell them not yet. But we're asking for it.

column14: ¡Recibido! Uy, perdón, era para otra nave.
column15: Copy! Oops, sorry, that was for another ship.
There's another ship?

column14: No. Me he confundido conmigo mismo.
column15: No. I confused myself.

column14: Control a nave: el jefe pregunta quién ha cambiado su silla.
column15: Control to ship: the boss asks who switched his chair.
We're in space.

column14: Eso le hemos dicho. No nos cree.
column15: That's what we told him. He doesn't believe us.
Control, can you sound more cheerful?
Sure! Hello! How nice! Nice!
Okay. A bit less.

column14: Os pongo con el jefe de vuelo. Bueno, está comiendo. Os pongo conmigo otra vez.
column15: Putting you through to the flight director. Well, he's eating. Putting you through to me again.

column14: Pequeño problema aquí abajo: se ha acabado el azúcar. Os mantenemos informados.
column15: Small problem down here: the sugar ran out. We'll keep you informed.

column14: ¡Cuidado con...! No, nada. Era una mancha en la pantalla.
column15: Watch out for...! No, nothing. It was a smudge on the screen.

column14: Aquí Control. Hoy estoy muy contento. Pedid lo que queráis.
column15: Control here. I'm very cheerful today. Ask for anything.
More cookies?
Not that. Something else.
